description_en: Returns a link to a CSV file that contains statistics on uplink and downlink data packets of a node
description_zh: 该链接指向一个 CSV 文件，其中包括了节点上下行数据包的统计数据
name: GetNodeTransferPacketsDownloadUrl

parameters.help_zh: 根据 GwEUI 过滤数据包
parameters.name: gw_eui

parameters.help_zh: 根据 DevEUI 过滤数据包
parameters.name: dev_eui

parameters.help_en:
The data packet category. Valid values:
DOWNLINK_PACKET: downlink packet
UPLINK_PACKET: uplink packet
INVALID_PACKET: invalid packet
parameters.help_zh: 数据包分类，可选：DOWNLINK_PACKET（下行包）、UPLINK_PACKET（上行包）、INVALID_PACKET（无效包）
parameters.name: category

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间，毫秒为单位的 UNIX 时间戳
parameters.name: begin_millis

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，毫秒为单位的 UNIX 时间戳
parameters.name: end_millis

parameters.help_en:
The field used for sorting. Valid values:
LOG_MILLIS: sorts by time
parameters.help_zh: 排序字段，可选 LOG_MILLIS（按照时间排序）
parameters.name: sorting_field

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to sort in ascending order. This parameter is used together with the SortingField parameter. Valid values:
true: ascending order
false: descending order

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
配合 SortingField 参数一起使用，true 表示升序，false 表示降序。

默认降序
parameters.name: ascending

Data.description_en: The download URL of the data packet statistics file
Data.description_zh: 数据包统计文件下载地址

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
